This synthetic two-page document exists only to feed the
minimal extractor of the anchored-review-forge skill.
Every sentence is fabricated and carries no real claims.

Anchored rendering draws one colored rectangle per block
so that a reviewer can trace each line back to the PDF.
The equation below is a stand-in with no derivation:

The caption below belongs to a figure that is not drawn,
which is fine for a geometry-only smoke test.
Figure 1: Schematic of the anchored review pipeline.

A trailing paragraph closes the first synthetic page
so that body blocks outnumber every other kind.

Words are clustered into lines by vertical proximity
and lines merge into blocks while the gap stays small.
The kind of each block is assigned by simple rules.

Rendering is one-to-one in PDF points with no scaling,
which keeps every rectangle easy to audit by eye.
End of the synthetic sample document.
